version: Odoo 18 legacy JSON-RPC only; other versions unverified
calls: object.execute_kw(database, uid, API key, model, search_read, [domain], options)
quantity: Internal locations only. Sum real quantity and available_quantity over lots/owners per product/location. Whole nonnegative units only. SKU from default_code; no catalogue metadata inferred.
permissions: Merchant must confirm API entitlement/hosting plan and complete stock/location/product read permissions; custom record rules can hide data. No writes.
verification: Official source inspected; mocked protocol tests; no live merchant verification.
